production_training_mesh: medium physics-controlled preset 5; sharp reference geometry
rounded_geometry: 2 mm radius semicircular end caps centered at (122,232) and (122,288) mm; envelope r=120..124 and z=230..290 mm; straight section z=232..288 mm.
stored_mph: Each mesh-reference model retains its solved field. Morris and training models retain only the last solved field plus all scalar sample records in modelDescription; they do not store a full field for every sample.
scope: Two equivalent reference end geometries, each tested at three local mesh sizes. The user-controlled local sequences are distinct from the coarse/medium/fine physics-controlled preset comparison. The surrogate training data were not refitted using the rounded geometry.
missing_probes: NaN values in the original gas-offset profiles are retained. The rounded L01 0.00001 mm end profile has 72 nonfinite rows out of 802; finer meshes and all 0.05 mm profiles are complete. Compare common finite points and report missing counts.
mesh_incidence_definition: Vertex-incident gas triangles share at least one vertex with an end-cap boundary edge; this is not limited to triangles that share the entire boundary edge.

data_layout.local: data/mesh/local/*.csv; filter by case and level
